summary: Iteration 2 (BUDGETS + ALERTS) tested end-to-end. critical_code_review_comments: Alert computation in server._compute_alerts is clean: handles zero/negative limits safely, sorts over → warning → percent desc, includes scope/category/threshold so the UI can color-code correctly.
alert_threshold is properly clamped on both /api/budgets and /api/settings/total-budget (50..100); list_budgets backfills alert_threshold=80 for older budgets via setdefault — good backward compat.
Total budget persisted in db.settings with type='total_budget' + month; idempotent upsert by (type, month). _id excluded via projection. No ObjectId leaks anywhere.

Frontend api.ts now exposes getTotalBudget / upsertTotalBudget / deleteTotalBudget / listAlerts and the dashboard() return type was extended with total_budget + alerts + alert_count — types match backend exactly.

Per-category threshold is reflected both in cardSub text ('Alert {X}%') and used by progress bar color (verified live: Food bar turned green at 60%/90%-threshold and would have been warning at 60%/50%-threshold).
